blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A real photograph is often blurry, grainy, compressed, scratched, and low-resolution at the same time. Each defect has its own severity and its own place in the image. The corrections for these defects conflict with each other. Exist- ing models describe the whole image with one description, so they cannot say where each correction belongs. To solve this problem, we present Wonder 4, a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model for image quality enhancement. It corrects several defects of a real photograph at the same time, each in the region where it occurs. Every block of the model holds a mixture of N = 13 experts. A router, trained with the model, sends every image patch to k = 5 of them. No degradation classifier, mask, prompt, detector, or task label is used. Another issue is that standard MoE training, taken from language models, pushes every expert toward equal use. Equal use applies every correction everywhere, even where it is not needed. We replace this rule with a bias that only sets a minimum share of use. Across all patches, an expert used less than this minimum gets higher router scores until it is selected again. An expert above the minimum is not changed, so no expert is forced to be used as often as the others. The bias needs no extra loss. The method adds no extra module and no extra processing step. We evaluate Wonder 4 on DIV2K and Flickr2K, against five published methods and three open-weight pipelines. It reaches the best LPIPS, DISTS, and NIQE on all three test settings (DIV2K x4, DIV2K x8, and Flickr2K x4).
blocks.zh: 真实的照片往往模糊,粒状,压缩,刮伤,同时分辨率低. 每一个缺陷在图像中都有其自身的严重程度和位置. 对这些缺陷的纠正相互冲突。 Exist-ing模型用一个描述来描述整个图像,所以它们不能说每个修正属于哪里. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了Wonder 4,一种增强图像质量的专家混合模型。 它同时纠正了真实照片的若干缺陷,每一照片发生在照片发生的地区。 该模型的每个区块都持有N=13位专家的混合物. 用模型训练的路由器将每个图像补丁发送到 k = 5 其中. 不使用降解分解器、遮罩、即时器、探测器或任务标签。 另一个问题是,从语言模型中抽取的教育部标准培训将每个专家推向平等使用。 平等使用适用于所有地方的纠正,即使不需要。 我们用一种只规定最低使用份额的偏见来取代这一规则。 在所有补丁中,使用少于此最小值的专家可以获得更高的路由器分数,直到再次被选中. 超过最低限的专家不改变,因此没有专家被迫像其他人一样经常被使用. 偏见不需要额外损失。 该方法没有添加额外的模块,也没有额外的处理步骤. 我们用DIV2K和Flickr2K来评价Wonder 4, 它在所有三个测试设置上都达到了最好的LPIPS,DISTS,和NIQE(DIV2K x4,DIV2K x8和Flick2K x4).

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A scanned family photograph is usually blurry from the lens and the scan, grainy from the film,
marked by compression bands, covered by dust and scratches from the print, and much lower in
resolution than people now want to view. Every defect is present at the same time. Each defect
has its own severity and is limited to its own part of the image. This is the ordinary case in
consumer photography, and we call it high-order mixed degradation . The required output
quality is much higher. A result is acceptable only if it still looks correct at full resolution,
with no softened edge, no invented texture, and no visible boundary between corrected and
untouched regions. That is the quality a photo retoucher aims for, and the quality we mean by professional-grade . These corrections conflict with each other. Removing noise also removes
film grain. Keeping the grain leaves the blur uncorrected. Removing a scratch adds false texture
if the same correction is applied to a clean sky. A model that improves this photograph must decide
not only how strongly to retouch each region but where , and it must apply incompatible
corrections to different regions of one image.

blocks.en:
Task-specific models for super-resolution, denoising, deblurring, compression-artifact
removal and damage repair are each trained on a degradation pipeline built for
one task and have never seen this combination of defects. Running them one after another has three
drawbacks: the order of the corrections must be chosen in advance, each model works on the invented
detail of the one before it, and a detector is needed to decide which model runs. Unified models were introduced to solve this problem, but they all stop for the same reason. They condition on a global description of the
degradation, whether inferred as a code [ 9 ] or
prompt [ 10 ] , borrowed from a vision–language
model [ 11 ] , written or planned as text [ 12 , 13 ] ,
predicted as the predominant class [ 20 ] , or set by a task
flag [ 21 ] . One
description for the whole image cannot say which region each correction belongs to, and getting that description
needs a second network, whose mistakes limit the whole result. This limitation also shows
in how the field evaluates these models. The standard test combines denoising, deraining,
dehazing, deblurring and low-light enhancement [ 22 ] , and the
corrections missing from that test are exactly the localized ones.
Neither pipelines of separate models nor these unified models handle high-order mixed degradation. A pipeline never sees the combined
defects and cannot apply conflicting corrections without detectors and a fixed order.
A unified model that conditions on one global description cannot assign incompatible
corrections to different regions of the picture.

blocks.en:
Because the image can be split into patches, a mixture of experts (MoE) is a good match: it computes a combination of corrections at every patch, rather than one decision about which task
is present. In language modeling the standard design is already fixed. An MoE network replaces each
dense layer with an MoE layer of structurally identical experts and a linear
router that selects a few experts for each input [ 1 , 2 , 4 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] ,
and the same layer is used without change in generative image
models [ 24 ] . Image restoration has not adopted it. Existing restoration
mixtures either select experts once per image or replace the experts with
prompts, adapters, or whole models chosen by an external degradation
estimator [ 17 , 16 , 14 , 15 , 19 , 18 ] .
Most of them also take a rule from language models: every expert should be used equally. This is
right when the experts do the same job, and harmful when a correction belongs on only a few patches.
Scratch removal is one such case, since a scratch covers only a small part of the image.

blocks.en:
We propose Wonder 4, which is the first MoE architecture for image quality enhancement.
Its experts are N = 13 N=13 structurally identical small networks, one MoE layer per block
of the backbone, selected k = 5 k=5 at a time per patch by a
router local to that block. The router needs no estimator, so each patch is routed
where its own defect occurs. One rule adapts the recipe to photographs. We add a
bias to the scores the router uses when it chooses experts [ 5 , 6 ] .
Each expert must be selected for at least a minimum share of the patches. If an expert is selected
less often than this minimum, that bias increases until the router selects it often enough. Once an expert is above the
minimum, the bias stops increasing, so a correction that belongs in only a few places stays
there.
Other models cover many defects by adding extra parts. Wonder 4 uses the standard mixture and adds nothing else: no second network to classify the damage,
no prompts, no mask, no second processing step, and no separate path for each task. Wonder 4 is released in a consumer application.

blocks.en: 2 Model
blocks.zh: 2 型号

blocks.en:
A photograph that needs several corrections, each in its own region, cannot be handled by one decision about the whole
image. It needs a decision at every location, and a way to apply more than one correction there. A sparse mixture
of experts does both, so Wonder 4 uses its standard form. An MoE layer of identical experts replaces the standard dense layer of each block. A linear
router is placed in each layer. It selects the top k k experts for each patch. To achieve better performance, we change one thing in Wonder 4: each expert is
given a minimum share of use instead of an equal share, so a correction is applied only where it is needed ( Sec. 2.4 ). This section first describes the architecture,
then the MoE layer, the router, expert training, and the training objective.

blocks.zh: 2.1 示范建筑

blocks.en:
Figure 2 shows Wonder 4. It takes the low-quality input image y y , resized to the target resolution, and
produces the enhanced image x ^ \hat{x} . A backbone network with L L blocks of width d d does the work. It operates on
patches of the image. An
MoE layer with its own router replaces the standard dense layer in every block.
This backbone fits a per-patch mixture. Splitting the image into patches gives every region its
own unit, so each region can be routed separately. No second network is needed to estimate the damage.

blocks.en:
The usual rule pushes every expert toward equal use [ 2 ] . That rule is right when experts are meant to do the same job, but it is wrong in our case. Some experts are needed in only a small part of the images.
Under an equal-use rule, an expert that is needed on only a small subset of patches, such as the physical-damage expert, is also applied to patches where it should not be used. Stars in a night sky are one such case. The same bright points are physical damage anywhere else in a photograph, and a user expects them to be removed, but in a photograph of the night sky they are the subject and must not be erased.
Every expert then learns the same average correction. We keep the usual balancing mechanism, a bias on the selection scores, and change its
target. Each expert has a minimum share of the routing weight, summed over all patches. The router still selects only k = 5 k=5 experts for each patch. An expert below its minimum gets higher selection scores until it is selected often enough, so no expert is left unused.
An expert above its minimum is not changed, so no expert is forced to be used more often than the training images need.
blocks.zh:
通常的规则将每个专家推向平等使用[2]. 当专家打算从事同样的工作时,这一规则是正确的,但就我们的情况而言,这是错误的。 只有一小部分图像需要一些专家。
在平等使用规则下,只需要一小块补丁的专家,如物理损害专家,也适用于不应使用的补丁。 夜空中的星星就是这样的 同样的亮点是照片中其他任何地方的物理损伤,一个用户期望它们被移除,但是在夜空的照片中,它们就是主体,决不能被抹去.
然后,每位专家都学会同样的平均修正。 我们保持通常的平衡机制, 偏向选择分数,并改变它的
目标。 每个专家拥有最小的路由权重份额,汇总在所有补丁上. 路由器仍然只为每个补丁选择k=5k=5专家. 低于其最低水平的专家获得较高的选择分数,直到它经常被选中,所以没有专家被闲置.
超过最低限的专家不会被改变,因此没有任何专家被迫被比训练图像需要的更多使用.

blocks.en: 2.5 Training Objective
blocks.zh: 2.5 培训目标

blocks.en:
The model is trained end to end in a single run. Three small loss terms are added to the enhancement loss. The ST-MoE
router z z -loss keeps the router’s scores from growing too large [ 3 ] . An entropy penalty on the
routing weights, increased gradually during training, pushes each patch to give most of its weight to only a few of its five experts. A third
penalty applies when the cosine similarity of two experts’ weights exceeds a threshold c 0 c_{0} . This penalty keeps experts from
learning the same correction. Experts can still overlap where their corrections should overlap. The
enhancement loss is a weighted sum of mean squared error (MSE) terms, LPIPS [ 31 ] and
an adversarial term, which rewards realistic images.
blocks.zh:
该型号被训练为单跑结束. 增强损失中增加了三个小损失条款. ST -MoE (英语)
路由器 z - loss 防止路由器的分数增长过大 [3]. py刑
路由权重,在训练期间逐渐增加,推动每个补丁将大部分权重给予其五名专家中的少数. 第三个
当两位专家的权重的余弦相似度超过一个阈值c 0 c_{0}时适用惩罚. 这种惩罚使专家无法进入
学习相同的校正。 在更正应重叠之处,专家仍可重叠。 这个
增强损失是平均方差(MSE)术语、LPIPS[31]和
对抗性术语,奖励现实形象。

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Benchmarks. We use three test settings. The first is DIV2K validation ( 100 100 images) under the mixed × 4 \times 4 degradation of the NTIRE 2018 challenge, called wild × 4 \times 4 [ 33 , 34 ] . Blur, noise and
compression are mixed, and their strength varies from image to image. The second is DIV2K validation at × 8 \times 8 bicubic downsampling ( 100 100 images). At this scale, simply resizing the image is not enough, so methods must
create the missing detail. The third is Flickr2K at × 4 \times 4 ( 2 650 2\,650 images) [ 35 ] . This set is
large enough that a difference in the average score is reliable. No DIV2K or Flickr2K image was used to train Wonder 4.
Several baselines, for example Real-ESRGAN, include both datasets in their training data.
blocks.zh:
基准。 我们使用三个测试设置。 第一种是混合×4 \time 4 的 NTIRE 2018 挑战的 DIV2K 验证(100 100 图像),称为 野×4 \time 4 [33, 34]. 模糊、噪声和
压缩是混合的,其强度因图像而异. 二是DIV2K验证在 × 8\时 8 bicubic 下取样(100幅图像). 在这个尺度上,仅仅调整图像的大小是不够的,所以方法必须
创建缺失的细节。 第三个是Flickr2K, at × 4\times 4(2 650 2\ 650图像) [35]. 这个是
足够大,平均得分的差异是可靠的。 没有使用DIV2K或Flickr2K图像来训练Wonder 4.
一些基线,例如Real-ESRGAN,将两个数据集都纳入其培训数据。

blocks.en:
Metrics. We report PSNR on the Y (brightness) channel, where higher is better, and the perceptual metrics LPIPS [ 31 ] ,
DISTS [ 32 ] and NIQE [ 30 ] . LPIPS and DISTS compare with the ground truth, the original sharp image. NIQE does not.
blocks.zh:
度量衡. 我们在Y(亮度)频道上报告PSNR, 其中较高程度更好, 以及感知度量LPIPS [31],
[32]和NIQE [30]。 LPIPS和DISTS比较地面真实性,原始锐利的图像. NIQE没有。

blocks.en:
Compared methods. We compare against five published enhancement systems, Real-ESRGAN [ 25 ] ,
StableSR [ 26 ] (the authors’ few-step Turbo variant), SeeSR [ 27 ] ,
SUPIR [ 28 ] and OSEDiff [ 29 ] , and three widely adopted open-weight pipelines, the
FLUX.1 ControlNet upscaler [ 38 ] , the Stable Diffusion × 4 \times 4 upscaler [ 36 ] and Qwen-Image-Edit [ 37 ] . All baselines run at their authors’ default settings.
blocks.zh:
比较方法. 我们比较了五个公布的增强系统 Real-ESRGAN [25],
StableSR [26] (提交人的几步涡轮变体),见SR [27],
SUPIR [28] 和 OSEdiff [29], 以及三条广泛采用的开放式管道,
FLUX.1 管制 网易升级器[38],稳定传播器×4\时4升级器[36]和Quen-Image-Edit[37]. 所有基线都在作者的默认设置中运行 。

blocks.en: 3.2 Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 量化结果

blocks.en:
Table 1 gives the comparison. Wonder 4 reaches the best LPIPS, DISTS
and NIQE on every test setting, against both the published methods and the open-weight pipelines. The gains are largest on Flickr2K. There it lowers LPIPS by 19 % 19\% and DISTS by 27 % 27\% relative to the strongest published baseline. Among the open-weight pipelines,
Qwen-Image-Edit is the closest on the metrics that use the ground truth. Wonder 4 still improves on it by 18 % 18\% in LPIPS and 16 % 16\% in DISTS on DIV2K × 4 \times 4 , by 25 % 25\% and 22 % 22\% on DIV2K × 8 \times 8 , and by 10 % 10\% and 15 % 15\% on Flickr2K.
blocks.zh:
表1作了比较。 神奇4达到最好的LPIPS,DISTS
和NIQE在每一个测试环境, 与公布的方法和开放重量的管道。 在Flickr2K上收益最大. 与最强的公布基线相比,LPIPS下降了19%,DISTS下降了27%。 在开放式管道中
Quen-Image-Edit最接近于使用地面真理的度量衡. 在DIV2K × 4 \time 4上,Wonder 4仍能改善18%的LPIPS和16%的DISTS,在DIV2K × 8 \time 8上则能改善25%的25 %和22%的22 %,在Flickr2K上能改善10%的10 %和15%的15 %。

Wonder 4 does not have the highest PSNR. The methods with the highest PSNR change the input the least, and they rank in the lower half on
the perceptual metrics. This is the usual trade-off. A model that adds detail looks better and gets a worse

the ground-truth image contains. Those scores reward the extra detail, and metrics that compare with the ground truth give it

blocks.en: 3.3 Real Photographs with Mixed Defects
blocks.zh: 3.3 混合缺陷真实照片

blocks.en:
Figure 3 shows real photographs with several defects at once: dust and scratches on scanned prints,
heavy grain from low light, compression blocks on fur, and blur together with grain. The test settings above
are super-resolution settings. They test only one kind of correction. Real photographs test the mixture. Here, Wonder 4 applies the
corrections each region needs, together with upscaling, in one pass. It uses no detector, mask or task label.

blocks.en: 3.4 Localized Expert Routing
blocks.zh: 3.4 本地化的专家路线

blocks.en:
A mixture only helps if the router makes a separate decision at each location. A router that selects the same experts everywhere,
or one set of experts for the whole image, could still get a good score while failing to do this. We inspect the routing directly. Each block
makes one routing decision per patch, so the routing of a block can be drawn as one map. For every patch we take
the expert with the highest routing probability, its first choice, and place it on the patch grid, lined up with
the photograph ( Figure 4 ). Experts are identified by index only. We assign no job to any of them.

或一组专家为整个画面, 仍然可以得到一个好的分数 同时没有做到这一点。 我们直接检查路线 每个区
使每个补丁有一个路由决定,所以一个块的路由可以绘制成一个地图. 我们的每一个补丁
将它放在补丁网格上 并排成一列
照片(图4) 专家仅按指数确定。 我们不给他们分配任何工作。

image changes.

The same effect can be measured without the picture. Writing w i w_{i} for the routing weights of Eq. 4 and w ¯ = 1 T ​ ∑ i w i \bar{w}=\frac{1}{T}\sum_{i}w_{i} for their average over the T T patches of one image, the
within-image routing mutual information ( H H is entropy) I ( ℓ ) = H ⁡ ( w ¯ ( ℓ ) ) − 1 T ​ ∑ i H ⁡ ( w i ( ℓ ) ) ∈ [ 0 , log ⁡ N ] I^{(\ell)}\;=\;H\big(\bar{w}^{(\ell)}\big)-\tfrac{1}{T}\textstyle\sum_{i}H\big(w^{(\ell)}_{i}\big)\;\in\;\big[0,\ \log N\big] (6) measures how much a patch’s routing depends on which patch it is, inside one image. Averaged over all L L blocks, I ≈ 0.89 I\approx 0.89 nats (natural-log units), against a maximum of log ⁡ 13 ≈ 2.56 \log 13\approx 2.56 . Being above zero matters as much as the exact value, because a value of zero would mean there is no per-patch decision.
A router that ignores location, and one that decides once per image, both give I ≈ 0 I\approx 0 . A value clearly
above zero can only come from patches of the same image being routed differently. A correction can change from
place to place only when that is true.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
A real photograph has several defects at the same time, and the corrections conflict. A single model for every defect was limited by
two things. One description per image cannot say where a correction belongs. Equal use of experts applies every correction everywhere, even where it is not needed.
Wonder 4 removes both limits. It keeps the standard sparse mixture: N = 13 N=13 experts per block, and k = 5 k=5 selected per patch by a router. Each expert
gets a minimum share of use instead of equal use. No classifier, estimator, mask, or task label is used.
On DIV2K and Flickr2K, Wonder 4 reaches the best LPIPS, DISTS, and NIQE on every test setting, against published methods
and open-weight pipelines. The routing maps ( Fig. 4 ) show decisions made inside each image. The method does not depend
on our network, our data, or our set of defects. We offer it as a simple, effective baseline for sparse mixtures
in image enhancement.
